tier1.headline: Your data is sold/shared
tier1.quote: We disclose the following categories of personal information to third parties for the purpose of engaging in targeted advertising (these disclosures may be considered "sales" or "sharing" under certain State Laws): Identifiers, Internet and electronic network activity, App usage and diagnostic information, Inferences, Advertising and marketing partners.

tier1.headline: Your content trains AI
tier1.quote: Improving our content moderation algorithm based on Contributions that are illegal or violate our Terms of Service.

tier1.headline: Your profile is inferred
tier1.quote: Inferences we generate about your use of our Services.

tier1.headline: Your data collected without account
tier1.quote: We collect personal information from several sources: directly from you (for example, when you make purchases or participate in a survey or contest), automatically when you use the Services (for example, browser information), and from other sources (for example, ad networks).

tier2.headline: Your data is shared broadly
tier2.quote: We may disclose your personal data to... Our corporate affiliates under common control and ownership.

tier2.headline: Your data retained 10 years
tier2.quote: Personal data processed for Defense purposes will be kept for no more than ten (10) years from your last interaction with our Services, or from the expiration of your subscription.

tier2.headline: Your approximate location collected
tier2.quote: In the preceding 12 months, we have collected the following categories of personal information: ... approximate geolocation information (such as country).

tier2.headline: Your behaviors are profiled
tier2.quote: To analyze your usage information, including your preferences, interests and behaviors when you use our Services (" Profiling ").

tier2.headline: Your data transferred globally
tier2.quote: We may transfer personal data from the European Economic Area (" EEA ") to other countries outside the EEA.

tier2.headline: Your data shared without warrant
tier2.quote: Public, judicial and/or police authorities, within the limits established by applicable laws.

tier2.headline: Your deletion rights are limited
tier2.quote: Upon the expiration of the mentioned retention periods, unless specific legal obligations require that the data is retained for longer, the data is either deleted or anonymized.
